Curated picks from "Kenney Game Assets All-in-1" v3.7.0 (www.kenney.nl).

License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain). Free to use in personal, educational
and commercial projects; no permission required; credit is voluntary.
Credit: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)

Files in this folder are a curated subset of the purchased library, kept in the
repo as the build-time source for tools/build_assets.py (which copies them into
public/assets/). Layout:
  sfx/       Interface Sounds (click, confirmation, error) + Impact Sounds
             (plate/glass/wood/punch heavy) — one-shot combat & UI SFX
  jingles/   Music Jingles (Retro) — wave-clear stinger
  music/     Music Loops — defeat track
  fx/        Pixel Explosion frames + Particle Pack (spark/magic/smoke/star)
             — white or pre-tinted one-shot FX sheets (individual frames)
  icons/     Game Icons white 1x sheet + libGDX-style XML atlas, plus three
             individual icons from Game Icons Expansion (cloud, coin, flag)
